hospital.name: Healdsburg Hospital
hospital.snippet: Healdsburg Hospital is the primary inpatient, outpatient and emergency care provider for the 60,000 residents of Healdsburg, Windsor, Geyserville and Cloverdale.

police.name: Windsor Police Department
police.snippet: In 1992 the Town of Windsor voted to contract with the Sonoma County Sheriff's Office for the provision of law enforcement services.
